summary: Iteration 43 — Mobile PWA + Twilio Voice SDK (WebRTC) token. All backend (12/12) and frontend flows tested at 390x844 (iPhone-14). JWT payload verified (sub=account_sid, iss=api_key_sid, voice grant with outgoing application_sid + incoming.allow=true, identity=twin-<user_id>, ttl=3600). PWA assets (manifest.json, sw.js, icon-192/512) served correctly with valid PNG magic bytes and no auth. index.html contains all PWA meta tags (apple-mobile-web-app-capable, status-bar-style, apple-touch-icon, viewport-fit=cover, manifest link). /m redirects to /m/call, unauth users are redirected to /login. Bottom tab bar (call/capture/history) with correct data-testids renders and navigates. WebRTC-configured user shows in-app-call-btn + pstn-call-link; clicking it fetches /twilio/voice/token 200 OK and (correctly) fails Twilio Voice SDK negotiation with AccessTokenInvalid because seeded creds are fakes — expected per test brief. Capture tab has capture=environment + accept=image/* on photo input. History tab shows 'No calls yet — the twin's number is quiet.' empty state.
critical_code_review_comments: MobileHistory.jsx uses c.from/c.to fields, but the backend stores call log entries with keys `from_number`/`to_number` (see twilio_voice.py:213 & 383). Rendered value will always be 'unknown' when calls actually exist. Consider `c.from_number || c.to_number || 'unknown'`. (Non-blocking: passes empty-state test since no calls exist for the test user.)

twilio_voice.py: put_config always overwrites api_key_sid/api_key_secret/twiml_app_sid with '' if fields not provided in payload. This makes PUT non-partial — any legacy client that PUTs only account_sid/auth_token/phone_number will silently blank out previously-saved WebRTC creds. Consider preserving prior values when payload fields are None (not just empty string).

MobileCall.jsx registers Twilio Device on button press, but a browser without granted mic permission will throw during device.connect. Consider requesting getUserMedia({audio:true}) first for a clearer permission prompt UX.

sw.js caches /api/* responses including per-user data (webrtc token, calls list) in the browser cache. On shared devices this leaks. Consider skipping cache for endpoints returning user-scoped PII or gating by Cache-Control response headers.
test_credentials: session_token=test_routing_session, user_id=test-routing-user (pre-seeded WebRTC config in db.user_twilio). Scratch users prefixed TEST_iter43_ are auto-cleaned by the fixture teardown.
seed_data_creation: None persistent — fixture creates TEST_iter43_<ts> users then deletes them.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 43 backend test file test_iteration43_mobile_pwa.py covers JWT decoding, empty-config branches, PWA static assets, and PWA meta tags — reuse it as regression. Note: BASE_URL is loaded via helper (env var or /app/frontend/.env fallback). WebRTC seeded user is test-routing-user; if next iteration touches db.user_twilio schema, re-verify seeded doc still has account_sid/api_key_sid/api_key_secret/twiml_app_sid.
